title: Senior QA Automation & Manual Tester
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced QA Automation & Manual Tester to support enterprise application quality assurance initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining test strategies, building automation frameworks, executing manual and automated testing, validating integrations, and ensuring release readiness across multiple delivery cycles. This role requires strong expertise in quality engineering, test automation, API testing, Azure DevOps, and Agile delivery practices.
  
  
**Scope Of Work & Key Responsibilities**

* Define, develop, and maintain test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases across System Testing, Integration Testing, and UAT phases.
* Design and implement scalable automation frameworks and reusable test scripts.
* Identify automation opportunities and improve overall test coverage and efficiency.
* Execute manual and automated tests for functional, regression, integration, UI, performance, and non-functional testing requirements.
* Develop and maintain Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM) to ensure end-to-end requirements coverage.
* Validate APIs, integrations, databases, and data consistency across enterprise applications.
* Perform test execution, result analysis, defect logging, retesting, and closure validation.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and support effective defect resolution.
* Support CI/CD integration and continuous testing processes within Agile delivery environments.
* Create and maintain test documentation, automation guidelines, standards, and knowledge repositories.
* Perform data validation and reconciliation during migration and production deployment activities.
* Support production deployment verification, release validation, and troubleshooting activities.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and stakeholders to ensure quality objectives are achieved.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide test status reports, execution metrics, risk assessments, and quality dashboards.
* Mentor team members and contribute to quality engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in Automation and Manual Testing.
* Strong experience across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including design, testing, implementation, and support.
* Expertise in designing test strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as:
* Playwright
* Selenium
* Similar automation frameworks
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps (ADO), including:
* Test Plans
* Work Item Tracking
* CI/CD Integration
* Experience with:
* JMeter
* SonarQube
* API Testing Tools
* Test Automation Frameworks
* Strong understanding of:
* Functional Testing
* Integration Testing
* Regression Testing
* UI Testing
* Performance Testing
* Security Testing
* Experience with RTM creation and test coverage management.
* Strong knowledge of defect management processes and RCA methodologies.
* Experience in SQL-based data validation and database testing (Azure SQL / MSSQL).
* Hands-on experience validating REST APIs and system integrations.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment models.
* Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Java, Python, JavaScript, or other scripting/programming languages used in automation.
* Exposure to enterprise API integrations and service validation.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted testing tools and automation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of quality engineering frameworks and process optimization.
* Experience leading testing initiatives within distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to lead API quality for a Spring Boot microservices platform hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You’ll design, build, and maintain scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured or Karate, and BDD practices, while integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
In this role, you’ll collaborate with developers, product teams, architects, and integration partners to shape testable designs, identify quality risks, and ensure services meet functional, performance, and security standards. You’ll help define QA strategy and team practices, manage test cases and execution using Jira and Xray, and use AI-enabled tools to support test design, automation, and analysis.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong Java and API testing expertise, experience with Spring Boot, cloud-native technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, and GCP, plus familiarity with Agile delivery, databases, Git, and CI/CD tools. Knowledge of API security, contract or performance testing, monitoring tools, and eCommerce is an advantage. A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  
  

* Leadership and Strategy
* Develop and execute a comprehensive API automation strategy aligned with the organization's quality goals.
* Identify and introduce innovative testing approaches, tools, and technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of QA processes.
* Stay current with trends in API automation, AI-assisted testing, and cloud-native testing, and apply them where they add value.
* Promote a culture of quality ownership and accountability within the team.
* API Automation Development
* Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured (or Karate), and BDD principles (Cucumber/Gherkin).
* Write clean, well-documented, maintainable automation scripts to validate API functionality, performance, and security.
* Implement data-driven testing strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI) for continuous testing.
* Build reusable frameworks and integrate SaaS frameworks to improve scalability and efficiency.
* Perform API testing and exploration with tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
* Apply API security testing principles (for example, OWASP) and validate data quality, including with large datasets.
* AI-Enabled Testing
* Use a range of AI models in day-to-day testing, including generating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
* Set up and configure AI agents to automate testing tasks and speed up test design, execution, and analysis.
* Evaluate new AI models and tools, and recommend how the team should adopt them.
* Test Management with Jira and Xray
* Create, organize, and maintain test cases in Xray.
* Integrate Xray with Jira to provide traceability between requirements, tests, executions, and defects.
* Build and manage test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
* Plan and track test execution and report results in Jira and Xray.
* Keep test plans, procedures, scripts, results, and configuration documented in Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira.
* Collaboration and Communication
* Work with developers, product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure testability.
* Participate in design and architecture reviews to give feedback on testability and flag quality risks early.
* Work with extended integration partner teams to define and execute exploratory and automated API tests.
* Communicate test results and quality metrics to stakeholders clearly and concisely.
* Take part in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to product design and architecture discussions.
* Quality Assurance and Best Practices
* Establish and enforce QA guidelines, best practices, and standards across the team.
* Review code actively to ensure software quality and functional accuracy.
* Ensure all code follows secure coding practices and maintains code coverage of at least 70%.
* Write and maintain unit tests with JUnit or TestNG where applicable.
* Coding and Development
* Complete coding tasks to design specifications, with high quality and on schedule.
* Work under the guidance of a Technical Architect and contribute to the overall system design.
* Use Git and collaboration platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab for version control and code reviews.
* Cloud and Platform Testing
* Validate microservices built with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, including RESTful APIs and dependency-injection-based components.
* Test services deployed on GCP (for example, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions), using Docker and Kubernetes environments.
* Validate data in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
* Operational Support
* Handle operational issues with minimal oversight, and troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly.
* Use monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to diagnose issues where available.
* Nice-to-Have Contributions
* Implement contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
* Run performance tests with JMeter or Gatling.
* Apply eCommerce domain knowledge to improve test scenarios and coverage.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation.
* Experience working in Agile teams and taking part in sprint ceremonies.

**API Automation**

* Extensive hands-on experience with RestAssured for API testing.
* Proficiency in BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
* Knowledge of API security testing principles and tools (for example, OWASP).
* Experience designing data-driven tests and building reusable automation frameworks.

**AI Tools and Automation**

* Familiarity with a range of AI models and their strengths.
* Comfortable using AI models in day-to-day testing, including creating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
* Experience setting up AI agents for test automation.

**Java and Spring Boot**

* Strong proficiency in Java and related open-source technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud for building microservices.
* Working knowledge of dependency injection, RESTful APIs, and other core Spring concepts.

**Cloud Technologies**

* Solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and architectures.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions.

**Testing Frameworks and Tools**

* Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and TestNG.
* Proficiency with IDEs such as Eclipse or IntelliJ IDEA.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.

**Test Management (Jira and Xray)**

* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Xray.
* Experience creating test cases in Xray and integrating Xray with Jira.
* Experience creating test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
* Experience using Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira for documentation, scripts, results, and configuration.

**Databases and Data Quality**

* Basic knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
* Experience with data quality testing and working with large datasets.

**Version Control and Collaboration**

* Proficiency with Git.
* Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab.

**Quality and Secure Coding**

* Ability to follow secure coding practices and maintain code coverage of at least 70%.
* Experience reviewing code for quality and functional accuracy.
* Experience writing and maintaining test plans, procedures, and scripts.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Eagerness to learn the product's design and architecture and to take part in ceremonies that influence both.
* Ability to handle operational issues with minimal oversight.

**Nice to Have**

* Contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
* Performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
* Monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
* Good understanding of the eCommerce domain.

We are seeking a
**Java Developer & Support Engineer**
with 4+ years of experience in Core Java and strong expertise in Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, and SQL. The ideal candidate will be responsible for both application development and production support, including troubleshooting, incident management, deployment support, and performance optimization. The role requires hands-on experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, log monitoring, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure application stability and timely issue resolution.
  
  

* Looking for a candidate with 4–6 years in Site Reliability Engineering / Production Support with strong exposure to high availability, performance, incident management, SLA adherence, RCA, problem and change management, observability and capacity planning.

* Practical experience in OpenShift/OCP : application deployment, managing pods/deployments/services/routes, working with ConfigMaps/secrets, resource monitoring , log analysis , rollback and scaling in production environments.

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kubernetes, Docker, Prometheus, Splunk/ELK, Git, CI/CD, Jenkins and DevOps practices, with SQL skills and exposure to at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Ability to track and improve production availability, latency, error rates, incident trends; enhance monitoring/alert coverage and automation; optimize batch/feed processing and overall application performance.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; clear communication and stakeholder management; high ownership and accountability under production pressure and tight SLAs.
* Proven ability to work effectively with development, infrastructure, business and upstream/downstream teams across locations and time zones, especially during incidents and major releases.
* Willingness to participate in on-call/support rotations as required and manage production issues during extended or off-business hours.

**Description**
We are seeking a talented QA Engineer to own the quality of new Alexa devices. In this role, you will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to own the end-to-end product quality of new Alexa devices, from product inception until it reaches the customer's hands. You will design and build AI-based automation tools and frameworks to support new device feature and non-functional testing.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end release quality for assigned new and experimental Alexa devices, from branch cut through WOTA release.
  
  
Drive daily BAT execution and weekly regression cycles; analyze results and ensure timely failure resolution.
  
  
Triage bugs by severity, track fix versions, and coordinate with development teams to prevent release blockers.
  
  
Monitor crash rates and adoption metrics during OTA ramps; escalate anomalies to stakeholders.
  
  
Coordinate release sign-off activities, including wiki creation, component POC follow-ups, and GM readiness validation.
  
  
Execute weekly beta publishes and validate customer-reported bugs for assigned devices.
  
  
Collaborate with feature teams, TPMs, and cross-location PQA teams to drive seamless release execution.
  
  
Design and maintain AI-based automation tools and frameworks to improve test coverage and execution efficiency.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a high-performing team of engineers — including SDEs, SDETs, and QAEs — who build and maintain automation frameworks, AI-based testing tools, and lab infrastructure serving the Alexa Product QA needs.
  
  
As Alexa's device portfolio expands with new and experimental form factors in 2027, we are extending our charter into Product Quality Assurance (PQA) ownership — taking end-to-end accountability for release quality from branch cut through customer delivery. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a team that is scaling its impact, operating across time zones to provide round-the-clock quality coverage, and shaping how Alexa's next-generation devices reach customers.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience coordinating between technical teams, peers and business stakeholders
* Experience working with device technologies under development, familiarity with flashing firmware, basic device debugging and familiarity with reading/pulling device logs, or experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements
* Experience in leading/coordinating work for other test teams

title: Engineer II ,Software Development
description:

title: Risk User Acceptance Testing Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As a member of the Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G) Testing Team, the Senior Associate will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across FR&G functions. This role plays a critical part in validating system enhancements, risk tooling, regulatory‑driven changes, and new technology solutions prior to production deployment.
  
  
The Senior Associate will lead UAT planning and execution for releases, including defining UAT scope/approach, coordinating stakeholder engagement, ensuring audit-ready sign-off. This role will work closely with Risk Users, Product Owners, Technology Delivery Teams, and Business Analysts to ensure new capabilities meet the expectations and control needs of the Financial Risk & Governance organization prior to production release. Testing is performed in a controlled non‑production environment designed to simulate production as closely as possible.
  
  
Success in this role requires a strongly inquisitive mindset, an ability to understand a day‑in‑the‑life of Risk users, and a passion for improving both processes and systems. The Senior Associate will also contribute to the automation of UAT and help increase testing efficiency and repeatability across the organization.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**
Integration, Collaboration, and Discovery
  
  

* Support an environment that ensures employees understand how their efforts contribute to overall business strategy
* Manage assigned book of work, partnering with leadership to plan the future supply and demand of resources required
* Evaluate the testing status of assigned projects while identifying and escalating critical risks
* Partner closely with Financial Risk and Governance teams to understand functional workflows, risk processes, and control expectations.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Delivery Teams to shape epic‑level acceptance criteria, ensuring they properly reflect FR&G user needs and regulatory considerations.
* Develop a strong understanding of end‑to‑end risk processes, including how users interact with systems, data, and controls.
* Partner with team to ensure maintenance of UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.
* Maintain UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.

UAT Planning, Execution and Governance
  
  

* Drive UAT status governance (daily/regular reporting, risk/issues escalation, defect triage coordination) within Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) or similar lifecycle tools, ensuring all acceptance criteria are validated.
* Mentor testers; standardize templates, evidence expectations, and execution discipline.

title: Lead Quality Engineer (BI Automation – Playwright & Python)
description:
You will lead a QE team building a
**cross-platform BI Test Automation Framework**
in
**Python and Playwright**
that validates enterprise dashboards on
**Tableau, Power BI, and Looker**
. The core of the role is engineering test cases that are written once and run against all three platforms through a shared, tool-agnostic Python layer, covering data accuracy against
**BigQuery**
and source systems, filters and interactions, row-level security, visual rendering, and dashboard performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Leadership:**
  Own the BI QE strategy across functional, data, security, visual regression, and performance testing for Tableau, Power BI, and Looker; lead a team of QE engineers, set coding standards, review pull requests, and provide sprint-level quality sign-off.
* **Reusable Framework Architecture:**
  Design and own a
  **platform-agnostic Python framework**
  in which a single test case runs against Tableau, Power BI, and Looker. Use an
  **adapter / Page Object pattern**
  with a common BI interface (open dashboard, apply filter, set parameter, drill down, read KPI / table values, export data), with one adapter implementation per platform, so that new dashboards and platforms plug in without rewriting tests.
* **Playwright Automation:**
  Build robust UI automation with
  **Playwright for Python**
  , handling embedded iframes, shadow DOM, canvas / SVG-rendered visuals, lazy-loaded tiles, and asynchronous query rendering, using reliable locator strategies, explicit wait conditions, and network interception rather than fixed sleeps.
* **Test Authoring & Data-Driven Design:**
  Author test cases with
  **pytest**
  (fixtures, parametrisation, markers, plugins), optionally with
  **pytest-bdd / Gherkin**
  for business-readable scenarios; externalise dashboards, filters, expected KPIs, and user roles into YAML / JSON / CSV test data so the same suite scales across reports, environments, and platforms.
* **BI Data Validation:**
  Reconcile values shown on dashboards (KPIs, crosstabs, aggregations, totals, filtered views) against the expected results from
  **BigQuery SQL**
  or source systems; use platform exports and APIs (
  **Tableau REST / Metadata API**
  ,
  **Power BI REST API**
  ,
  **Looker API SDK**
  ) to extract underlying data where UI scraping is unreliable.
* **Security & Visual Validation:**
  Automate
  **row-level and column-level security**
  checks by executing the same scenarios under multiple user personas; implement
  **visual regression testing**
  with baseline screenshot comparison and tolerance thresholds for layout, branding, and rendering defects.
* **Performance Testing:**
  Measure dashboard load, filter-response, and render times using Playwright tracing, browser Performance APIs, and network timings; run concurrent-user scenarios with Python tooling and validate results against defined SLAs.
* **CI/CD & Release Gating:**
  Run suites in parallel through
  **GitHub Actions**
  with smoke, regression, and full-suite release gates; publish rich reports with screenshots, traces, and videos attached for failed tests.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Python (Core Requirement):**
  Expert-level
  **Python 3**
  with strong object-oriented design: abstract base classes, protocols, design patterns (Adapter, Factory, Page Object, Strategy), type hints, packaging, and dependency management (
  **Poetry / uv / pip**
  ). Proven ability to build reusable libraries, not just scripts, with clean code, linting (
  **ruff / black / mypy**
  ), and unit tests for the framework itself.
* **Playwright for Python:**
  Deep hands-on experience with
  **Playwright (Python, sync and async APIs)**
  : locators, auto-waiting, frame and shadow DOM handling, network interception and mocking, authentication state reuse, tracing, screenshots, video capture, and cross-browser execution (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit).
* **Test Frameworks:**
  Strong proficiency in
  **pytest**
  (fixtures, conftest hierarchies, parametrisation, custom plugins and hooks, markers); working knowledge of
  **pytest-bdd**
  or
  **behave**
  for BDD-style scenarios.
* **BI Platforms:**
  Practical testing experience on at least two of
  **Tableau**
  (Server / Cloud),
  **Power BI**
  (Service / Embedded), and
  **Looker**
  (Explores, Looks, dashboards, LookML), with an understanding of each platform's DOM structure, rendering model, filters, parameters, and security model.
* **BI APIs & Data Validation:**
  Experience with
  **tableauserverclient / Tableau REST and Metadata APIs**
  ,
  **Power BI REST API**
  , and the
  **Looker Python SDK**
  ; strong
  **SQL**
  (preferably
  **BigQuery**
  ) for writing expected-result queries; use of
  **pandas**
  for dataset comparison and tolerance-based numeric checks.
* **CI/CD Execution:**
  Experience orchestrating parallel test pipelines in
  **GitHub Actions**
  (or Jenkins / Azure DevOps), including Docker-based execution, secrets management, and scheduled regression runs.
* **Reporting:**
  Experience producing actionable test reports with
  **Allure**
  or equivalent, including screenshots, Playwright traces, and videos for failed tests, plus platform-wise coverage and trend metrics.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, with at least 3 years leading test automation for BI / analytics or data platform programmes.
* Demonstrated delivery of a
  **Python-based Playwright automation framework**
  in production use, ideally one reused across multiple applications or BI tools.
* Proven ability to design for reuse: a track record of building shared test libraries, abstraction layers, and data-driven suites that reduce per-dashboard automation effort.
* Experience leading and mentoring a QE team, conducting code reviews, and setting automation engineering standards.
* Strong analytical mindset to perform root cause analysis on dashboard discrepancies across the semantic layer, data model, and source data.

Good to have: experience with Selenium-to-Playwright migration, accessibility testing (axe-core), GCP / BigQuery

* Strong problem-solving ability and communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of software design patterns, unit testing, and maintainable code architectures.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty, Cloud Practitioner, or similar AI/cloud credentials.
* Ability to drive process improvements and identify gaps
* Proactive in engaging with customers, client executives and other Verizon teams
* Ability to excel in a team, as an individual, in a fast-paced deadline driven organization
* Experience implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized execution environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of AI security, guardrails, and risk mitigation techniques for automated agent workflows.

The ideal candidate will be instrumental in integrating security practices directly into our Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), particularly by establishing, tuning, and operating our DAST program and helping development teams remediate complex security vulnerabilities.
  
  

* Strategy & Implementation: Defining, implementing, and continuously maturing the organization's DAST strategy, integrating automated scanning into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Tool Management: Selecting, configuring, managing, and maintaining DAST solutions (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite Enterprise, or commercial tools like Tenable WAS).
* Scanning & Analysis: Performing comprehensive DAST scans on web applications, APIs, and microservices, analyzing results for false positives and reporting actionable vulnerabilities.
* Custom Scripting & Automation: Developing custom scripts and automation (using Python, Java, or Shell) to enhance DAST coverage, automate testing scenarios, and integrate DAST output with defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira).
* Vulnerability Remediation: Partnering directly with development teams to explain vulnerability root causes, provide secure coding examples, and guide them through the remediation process.
* Code Review: Conducting targeted security code reviews for critical applications, focusing on architectural security flaws and common specific vulnerabilities (e.g., deserialization issues, Spring/Struts security misconfigurations, injection flaws).
* Secure Coding Standards: Developing and promoting secure coding standards and best practices and associated frameworks.
* Documentation & Training: Creating high-quality documentation, training materials, and run hands-on workshops to elevate the security knowledge of engineering teams.
* Incident Response: Assisting in the investigation and resolution of application security incidents, providing deep technical insight into Java application behavior and potential attack vectors.
* Stay Current: Researching continuously for new attack techniques, security trends, and emerging Java-related vulnerabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
**You'll need to ha**
ve:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or two or more years of work experience.
* Three or more years of experience in Software Engineering, Application Security, or a related role.
* DAST Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience managing and operating DAST tools in an enterprise environment, including configuring authenticated scans and handling Single Sign-On (SSO) contexts.
* Java Development: Strong background (2+ years) in professional software development, primarily using Java and common frameworks (Spring Boot, Jakarta EE/JEE).
* Web Technologies: Expert understanding of web application architecture, HTTP protocols, RESTful APIs, and associated security controls (CORS, CSRF, XSS, etc.).
* Vulnerability Knowledge: Expert knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 or CWE/SANS Top 25.
* CI/CD: Experience integrating security tools (DAST, SAST) into automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
* Cloud: Familiarity with securing applications deployed on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g: CSSLP, OSCP, eJPT ).
* Experience with other security testing methodologies (SAST, IAST, Penetration Testing).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: Quality Engineer III
description:
**About Team**
The Health & Wellness Engineering team at Walmart is on a mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for millions of customers across the US. We build the technology that powers Walmart's pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and wellness platforms spanning prescription management, clinical workflows, patient-facing digital experiences, and health program delivery. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a Quality Engineer III for Walmart Health & Wellness, you'll have the opportunity to:
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and test suites that validate the quality, reliability, and compliance of Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms
  
  
Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and clinical stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, test strategies, and quality gates across the SDLC
  
  
Build and execute end-to-end, integration, regression, and API test suites for critical healthcare workflows including prescription processing, patient data management, and clinical integrations
  
  
Ensure all test coverage adheres to HIPAA compliance requirements and that test environments handle sensitive patient health information (ePHI) with appropriate data masking and privacy controls
  
  
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality validation and fast feedback loops for development teams
  
  
Perform thorough defect analysis, document bugs with precision, and work closely with engineers to drive timely resolution of issues
  
  
Contribute to shift-left quality practices — participate in design reviews, requirement grooming, and early-stage risk identification to prevent defects before they reach production
  
  
Adhere to Company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
BE/B Tech/ME/MTech in Computer Science or related technical field
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering with a focus on test automation
  
  
Test Automation — Java Stack — Proficiency in Java for building and maintaining automation frameworks; TestNG / JUnit 5, Selenium WebDriver with Page Object Model (POM), Maven / Gradle
  
  
API Test Automation — Hands-on experience with REST Assured and Postman / Newman; validating JSON / XML responses, status codes, schema validation, and end-to-end API workflow testing
  
  
BDD & Test Design — Cucumber + Gherkin for behaviour-driven test design; feature file authoring, step definition mapping, and data-driven test strategies
  
  
CI/CD Integration — Embedding test suites in Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Concord pipelines; parallel test execution, test reporting (Allure / ExtentReports), and quality gate enforcement
  
  
Database Validation — SQL proficiency for test data setup, teardown, and result verification; experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL and basic NoSQL awareness
  
  
Healthcare Domain Awareness — Understanding of HIPAA compliance, PHI / ePHI data handling in test environments, and familiarity with healthcare workflows (prescription lifecycle, clinical data, payer integrations) is a strong advantage
  
  
Engineering Fundamentals — OOP basics, Git branching strategies, code reviews, defect lifecycle management, and test documentation practices
  
  
Soft Skills — Analytical and detail-oriented mindset, precise defect reporting, collaborative, strong ownership of quality outcomes
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Flexible, hybrid work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal opportunity employer
  
  
Walmart, inc., is an equal opportunities employer – by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people

Minimum Qualifications:Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 2 years’ experience in software quality assurance, manual/automated testing, or related area.
  
  
Option 2: 4 years' experience in software engineering quality assurance, manual/automated testing, or related area.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.
  
  
Master's degree in Software Engineering Quality Assurance, Manual/Automated Testing, or related area, Quality assurance certification (for example, CSTE - Certified Test Engineer, CSQA - Certified Software Quality Analyst), Related industry experience (for example, retail, supply chain, eCommerce, healthcare), Software Engineering Quality Assurance, Manual/Automated Testing, or related area.

title: Lead/Sr. SQA Analyst
description:
**Our Mission:**

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content.

**About Us:**

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.

**Position Summary:**

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy & Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation & CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional & Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication.
* Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

**Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications**
:

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications:**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview:**
Global Markets Technology (GMT) and Global Payments Solutions Technology (GPST) groups provide end-to-end technology solutions for Global Banking and Markets businesses including Treasury, Trade Finance, Payments, Transaction Banking, Equities Trading, Prime Brokerage, Fixed Income, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives and Structured Products.
  
  
GMT & GPST groups have around 8000 resources in India and is involved in delivery of tech solutions for 1400+ applications. The group primarily delivers architecture, design, development, management, implementation and support using a wide range of technologies. The Delivery teams are doing extensive work in several regulatory, strategic and initiatives programs. In addition, the group has also established a strong partnership with the GBAM operations team in India to deliver automation and functional enhancements to the applications they are using
  
  
**Job Description:**
This role is responsible for leading technology delivery and modernization for mission-critical US Payments - Wires platforms. The VP will drive transformation across Fedwire, CHIPS, SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, routing, settlement, investigations, exception handling, and related integration services, with a clear focus on scalable engineering, resiliency, automation, and business outcomes.
  
  
The role requires strong wires modernization experience and deep hands-on technology credibility. The candidate should be able to convert modernization objectives into executable architecture and delivery plans, guide feature teams, partner with architecture, product, operations, compliance, fraud, and risk partners, and ensure solutions meet the control, resiliency, performance, and security standards expected for a Tier-1 payment rail.
  
  
A critical focus for this role is to modernize and build services around a vendor payment platform using Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, Oracle and/or distributed databases, Angular, APIs, microservices, and a modern containerized deployment model with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud or private-cloud infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities: -**

* Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed-system issues such as message parsing failures, routing defects, latency issues, data integrity gaps, resiliency failures, and integration errors.
* Experience working with regulatory and control expectations across OFAC, AML, sanctions, risk controls, audit, security, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Strong partnering and influencing skills to work across architecture, product, operations, compliance, fraud, risk, and global engineering teams.
* People and delivery leadership experience managing or leading feature teams, senior engineers, and cross-functional delivery squads, with the ability to improve engineering maturity and mentor technical talent.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI, agentic solutions, or automation-led engineering productivity improvements will be an added advantage.

**Requirements**
**Education:**
B.E./B. Tech/M.S./M. Tech or equivalent engineering qualification from a reputed institution.
  
  
**Certificates if any:**
NA
  
  
**Experience Range:**
17+ yrs.
  
  
**Foundational Skill:**

* Strong technology leader with proven experience delivering large-scale modernization and transformation programs in Payments, preferably Wires, within a bank or financial services organization.
* Strong software engineering and architecture capability, with the ability to guide design, delivery, quality, resiliency, and production readiness for complex payment platforms.
* Deep experience in modern engineering practices including microservices, event-driven architecture, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, containerization, Kubernetes, and agile delivery.
* Ability to translate business and regulatory priorities into practical technology roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading medium to large delivery teams or multiple feature teams across India and/or global locations.

title: Tech S And T - AI Integration Engineer Senior - GDSN02
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Designation AI Integration Engineer**
**Job Description**

* Build end‑to‑end AI/ML pipelines (training → evaluation → deployment) using MLflow/Kubeflow/Databricks/Weights & Biases with experiment tracking and model registries.
* Develop models with Python using PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit‑learn, and Hugging Face Transformers, package as reproducible services.
* Implement LLM/RAG systems with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel and vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, Chroma) for semantic retrieval and grounding.
* Fine‑tune and optimize models using PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed/Accelerate, distillation, and quantization; export/optimize via ONNX Runtime/TorchScript/TensorRT.
* Engineer scalable model serving with KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Triton, supporting A/B, canary, shadow deployments.
* Build evaluation harnesses (offline/online) with Ragas, TruLens, Promptfoo, golden datasets, and regression gates integrated into CI/CD.
* Construct feature stores (e.g., Feast) and data contracts (Protobuf/Avro/Pydantic); enforce data quality with Great Expectations/Deequ.
* Orchestrate event‑driven pipelines with Airflow/Prefect/Dagster; streaming/messaging via Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS and schema registries.
* Design Python microservices using FastAPI/gRPC; integrate with downstream systems via REST/GraphQL; write robust automation in Python/Bash/PowerShell and SQL for data ops.
* Use notebooks (Jupyter) and packaging (Poetry/pip/conda) with virtualenvs, environment locking, and artifacts suitable for promotion across stages.
* Apply testing & quality: pytest, unit/integration/e2e tests, property‑based (hypothesis), linters/formatters (ruff/flake8, black), type checks (mypy/pyright), pre‑commit.
* Deliver IaC with Terraform/Pulumi; manage config via Helm/Kustomize; implement GitOps with Argo CD/Flux on managed/self‑hosted Kubernetes.
* Build secure CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins/Azure DevOps) for app/data/ML artifacts, artifact promotion, provenance, and automated rollbacks.
* Embed DevSecOps: SAST/DAST/IAST (Snyk/Checkmarx/SonarQube), container & IaC scanning (Trivy), dependency hygiene (Dependabot/Renovate), SBOM (Syft/CycloneDX).
* Enforce policy‑as‑code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno), image signing/verification (Sigstore/cosign), supply‑chain standards (SLSA, in‑toto).
* Manage secrets/KMS with Vault and native managers; adopt short‑lived workload identities, mTLS, and least‑privilege RBAC/ABAC in clusters and pipelines.
* Implement AI safety & governance: prompt‑injection defenses, output filtering, PII redaction, guardrails (Guardrails.ai/NeMo Guardrails/Presidio), policy checks.
* Monitor model/data drift, bias, and performance with Evidently/WhyLabs/Arize/Fiddler; unify telemetry via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, Jaeger.
* Optimize compute/GPU: CUDA/cuDNN/NCCL, HPA/VPA/KEDA, efficient batching, caching, concurrency control; track cost and latency SLOs.
* Implement progressive delivery for services/models (blue/green, canary, shadow) using Argo Rollouts/Flagger with instant rollback and health checks.
* Operate API gateways and service mesh (Kong/NGINX/Envoy, Istio/Linkerd) for rate limiting, mTLS, authN/Z, and zero‑trust patterns.
* Ensure privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP/ISO 27001): data minimization, masking/tokenization, DLP, lineage (OpenLineage/Marquez), model cards/data sheets.
* Collaborate with security, data, and platform teams to publish golden paths, templates, and reference implementations for repeatable AI delivery.
* Contribute to code/design reviews and SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs/error budgets), on‑call readiness, incident response, and blameless post‑mortems.

**Desired Profile**

* Looking for a DevSecOps & AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud platforms, automation, and AI/ML engineering workflows.
* Strong expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Proficient in Python with experience in FastAPI, ML libraries (PyTorch/TensorFlow), and scripting using Bash or PowerShell for automation.
* Solid experience in DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, container/IaC scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy-as-code frameworks.
* Hands‑on exposure to MLOps and AI integration using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases, KServe, Seldon Core, or BentoML.
* Experience building or integrating RAG/LLM pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases (Pinecone/FAISS/Weaviate).
* Strong cloud fundamentals across AWS/Azure/GCP with ability to architect secure, automated infrastructure via IaC and GitOps (Argo CD/Flux).
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Loki) for application and model performance.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem‑solving, and system debugging skills with a collaborative, engineering‑first mindset.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to work cross‑functionally with Data, AI/ML, DevOps, Security, and Platform Engineering teams.

**Experience 4 To 7 Years**
**Education B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science**
**Technical Skills & Certifications**

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
Purpose
  
  
Own automated test coverage across backend (API/service/DB layers) and frontend (UI/component/E2E layers), driving toward near-100% automation coverage and ensuring every regression is caught before it reaches production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Build and maintain a comprehensive automated test suite spanning backend (pytest API/service/contract tests for FastAPI endpoints) and frontend (Vitest/RTL component tests, Playwright/Cypress E2E for Carbon UI flows).
  
  
Establish coverage tracking and gates in CI (GitLab CI), blocking merges that drop coverage below agreed thresholds.
  
  
Design regression suites keyed to historical defects/incidents so every fixed bug gets a permanent automated guard.
  
  
Automate cross-cutting scenarios: JWT access/refresh auth flows, role-based access (manager/admin), pagination/validation edge cases (422s), and DB integrity checks (is\_current = true filters, multi-table transactions).
  
  
Build data-driven and contract tests for API responses (success/error envelope, status codes) and schema validation (Pydantic).
  
  
Automate frontend flows for Carbon components, React Query loading/error states, and AG-Grid interactions (pagination/infinite scroll), including accessibility checks.
  
  
Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI pipelines with fast feedback (parallelization, flaky-test quarantine, retries with root-cause triage).
  
  
Maintain synthetic/production-safe test data and fixtures; support performance/load test scripts (k6/Gatling) alongside functional automation.
  
  
Triage automation failures rapidly to distinguish real regressions from flaky/environment issues; drive flaky rate to near zero.
  
  
Partner with developers to shift-left testing (unit tests written alongside features) while owning the E2E/regression safety net.
  
  
Must-Have Skills
  
  
Strong pytest skills for backend automation: API/integration tests against FastAPI + PostgreSQL (raw SQL), fixtures, mocking DB/AWS dependencies.
  
  
Strong frontend automation: Vitest + React Testing Library for components, Playwright or Cypress for E2E across Carbon-based UI.
  
  
CI/CD pipeline experience (GitLab CI) — wiring test stages, coverage gates, artifacts, parallel test execution.
  
  
Contract/schema testing experience (Pydantic schemas, OpenAPI) and validation-rule coverage (422 paths).
  
  
Auth-flow automation (JWT access/refresh, RBAC) and multi-tenant/cross-tenant data access test design.
  
  
Ability to read production incident/defect history and reverse-engineer regression tests from it.
  
  
Familiarity with performance/load testing tools (k6/Gatling) to complement functional automation.
  
  
Strong ownership of “automation coverage” as a metric — proactive about closing gaps, not just maintaining existing suites.
  
  
KPIs / Success Measures
  
  
Automated test coverage near 100% across both backend (endpoint/service/DB paths) and frontend (component/flow paths).
  
  
100% of confirmed regressions get a corresponding automated test before the fix is merged.
  
  
Escaped defect rate (bugs reaching production undetected by automation) trending to zero.
  
  
Flaky test rate below an agreed threshold; CI automation stage stays green and fast.
  
  
Common Requirements (emphasis for this role)
  
  
Emphasis: coverage completeness, regression-proofing, and CI-integrated automation across the full stack.
  
  
Proficient, responsible use of GenAI test-generation assistants to expand coverage quickly, with human review for correctness and security.
  
  
Quality and observability ownership — automation results feed directly into release-readiness decisions.

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists—engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders—around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients’ lives.
  
  
If you’re ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the engineering of the whole platform — the Python and FastAPI backend, the React web application, the mobile application, the Artificial Intelligence (AI) plug-ins and the cloud they run on — and be the single person accountable for whether it ships
* Lead through senior engineers who each own a group of modules, with the quality, cloud and mobile engineers shared across both, so no module has one person who cannot go on leave
* Split the work by what a hospital does rather than by technology: one team on the clinical side — records, orders, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy — and one on everything a hospital runs on — reception, billing, insurance, canteen, administration
* Set the technical direction and record it as decisions a new engineer can still read a year later, including the ones that were wrong and why they were changed
* Stay hands-on: review every change that touches a clinical record, a price, a ledger or a claim, and write the parts nobody else should be left alone with — tenancy, the billing engine, the synchronisation layer
* Be accountable for the pilot hospital going live, and for the fact that a ward at two in the morning is not a place where software gets a second chance

Delivery You Can Commit To
  
  

* Sequence the work so two teams run in parallel without waiting on each other, and say in the week it becomes likely — not in the week it becomes certain — that a date will move
* Hold estimates that hold: break work down until the team can commit to it, and treat an estimate that keeps slipping as a specification problem rather than an effort problem
* Own the release path end to end — trunk-based development, migrations only through version control, a deploy anybody on the team can run, and a rollback that has actually been tested
* Own what happens when it breaks at three in the morning: who is called, what they can see, and how the hospital is told before it telephones us
* Keep the weekly picture honest — what shipped, what slipped, what is at risk and what you need from the business — in a pack somebody outside engineering can read

Correctness, Because This Is a Hospital
  
  

* Hold the line on the paths where being wrong is not a bug but a harm: allergy and interaction checks, dose limits by age and weight, critical results that must reach a human, and money that must reconcile to the rupee
* Make every write auditable and attributable — who did it, when, and what it replaced; corrections by reversal, never by silent overwrite
* Build multi-tenancy in from the first table: one platform, many hospitals, and no path by which one can see another's data
* Own the security posture — access control, audit, encryption, secrets, and a third-party Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test the platform passes before go-live rather than after
* Own the standards work that cannot be compressed at the end: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) R4, Health Level Seven (HL7) version 2 from analysers, Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) worklists, and Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) with Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) linking

The People Part, Which Is Most of It
  
  

* Take a team that is already building and make it better at it — and own the hiring as it grows, being honest in the interview about what the job is: a hospital, a deadline and a real pilot, not a research project
* Grow the senior engineers into people whose review is trusted, so that within a year the hardest module is not yours to review
* Give feedback in the week it is useful, run the performance conversations, and make the growth path visible to a junior engineer who cannot yet see it
* Protect the team from thrash — take the interruption yourself, decide, and let them keep building
* Pair the engineers with the ward: every one of them should have sat beside a nurse or a billing counter before they design for one

Working With the Business
  
  

* Work with the Product Delivery Manager on scope and sequence, and with the Business Analyst on turning a hospital's actual documents — a tariff sheet, a rate contract, a scheme circular — into something the software can hold
* Say no with a reason and an alternative, in a sentence a hospital administrator can repeat to their own board
* Own the technical half of a customer conversation: what the platform does today, what it will do by go-live, and what it will not do at all
* Keep the demo honest — a screen shown to a hospital is a promise, and this team does not show what it cannot build

Tech Stack
  
  
Python
  
  

* FastAPI
* Pydantic
* SQLAlchemy
* PostgreSQL
* React
* TypeScript
* React Native
* AWS
* Docker
* Terraform
* GitHub Actions
* pytest
* Playwright
* FHIR
* HL7 v2
* ABDM

We build in Python on FastAPI with React in front of it, on Amazon Web Services. That is what this role writes, reviews and is accountable for, and we would rather say it plainly at the top than have you find out in week one.
  
  
What you will work in every day
  
  

* Backend — Python 3.12 with type hints everywhere, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0 in async mode, Alembic for migrations, and Structured Query Language (SQL) you write yourself when the query matters
* Typing, enforced — mypy or Pyright in strict mode, failing the build. Python's type hints are optional at runtime, so we make them non-optional in continuous integration
* Frontend — React 18 with TypeScript, function components and hooks, a data-fetching and caching library (TanStack Query or equivalent), schema-based validation (Zod or equivalent), and Vite
* Mobile — React Native, sharing types and validation with the web application
* API contract — FastAPI generates the OpenAPI schema, and the TypeScript client the web and mobile applications use is generated from it, so the contract cannot quietly drift
* Database — PostgreSQL 16: schema design, migrations, indexes and query plans, on Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) or Aurora
* Caching and queues — Redis on Amazon ElastiCache, and a task queue with idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling and replay: Celery, Dramatiq, arq or a PostgreSQL-backed queue
* Cloud — Amazon Web Services, which is where we build and run: Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Simple Storage Service (S3), CloudWatch, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Secrets Manager, and the Mumbai region for data residency
* Containers — Docker everywhere, so that a hospital insisting on Google Cloud or Azure is a piece of work rather than a rewrite. That is a possibility we design for, not a thing we are doing this year
* Infrastructure as code — Terraform, with the AWS estate defined in version control and nothing clicked in a console
* Delivery — GitHub Actions, trunk-based development, short-lived branches, code review on every pull request
* Testing — pytest and pytest-asyncio, Vitest or Jest with React Testing Library, and Playwright for the end-to-end journeys that protect money and clinical safety
* AI — the AI services are Python too, which is one of the reasons we chose it: models served behind the same contract discipline as everything else, subscribing to events and writing suggestions back, never writing directly into clinical or financial tables
* Healthcare standards — Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) R4, Health Level Seven (HL7) version 2 over Minimal Lower Layer Protocol (MLLP), Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10), Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA)

What we need you to have used in production
  
  

* Python, written with type hints and tested, in a service somebody depended on
* A modern relational database, PostgreSQL for preference — schema design, transactions, indexes, and reading a query plan
* React with TypeScript — enough to review a component, argue about state and know when a screen is wrong
* Amazon Web Services — an estate you owned rather than one you were handed, including what it costs at the end of the month
* Docker and a continuous integration pipeline you set up or repaired yourself
