title: Test Development Engineer
description:
Rotork is the market\-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
   

  

 Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Lead the development, execution, and maintenance of verification and validation strategies for complex embedded products.
   

  

 Architect, design, and enhance scalable test automation frameworks using LabVIEW and Python.
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end test lifecycle activities including test planning, test design, execution, defect analysis, and release sign A.
   

  

 Mentor and technically guide junior and mid\-level test engineers on best practices in test development and debugging.
   

  

 Drive root cause analysis of complex system\-level issues and work closely with design, firmware, and systems teams to resolve them.
   

  

 Define and enforce test standards, coding guidelines, and design patterns within the test organization.
   

  

 Perform advanced exploratory and stress testing to identify corner cases and systemic gaps.
   

  

 Review product requirements and specifications to proactively identify ambiguities, risks, and testability gaps. Develop comprehensive test plans, traceability matrices, and ensure complete requirement\-to\-test coverage.
   

  

* Actively participate in design reviews and contribute testability feedback early in the development cycle. Own and improve CI/CD integration for automated tests and test infrastructure. Lead defect triage discussions and influence prioritization based on risk and customer impact.


**Technical Skills:**
* Expert\-level experience in automated and manual testing of embedded systems, with strong specialization in LabVIEW. Deep understanding and practical application of LabVIEW design patterns and modular test architectures. Advanced proficiency in NI TestStand for complex test sequencing, reporting, and parallel execution. Strong experience with version control systems, branching strategies, code reviews, and change management.
* In\-depth knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and mature defect management processes. Extensive hands\-on experience with lab equipment such as: Multimeters, Loop calibrators, Digital storage oscilloscopes, Protocol analyzers
* Strong expertise in embedded systems testing and industrial communication protocols such as: CAN, Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet\-based industrial protocols


 Proven ability to design and implement custom test automation frameworks in Python.
   

  

 Experience with test data analysis, logging, and result visualization.
   

  

 Familiarity with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level test environments is a plus.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience:**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
   

  

 8–12 years of hands\-on experience in the embedded systems testing domain, with a strong emphasis on test automation, test development, and system level validation.
   

  

 Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, NI CLD/CLA, or equivalent professional credentials are a plus.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision\-making skills with the ability to handle ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to collaborate Actively with global stakeholders and native English speakers.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities.
   

  

 Ability to work independently while influencing cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

title: Sr.Princ SQA Engineer
description:
**About Gen**
 Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award\-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.
   

  

 Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect cosumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high\-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.
   

  

 When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well\-being programs.
   

  

 At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll join our Mobile Development team, building secure and highly scalable mobile apps that protect the digital lives of consumers and
   

  

 small businesses. As a senior quality leader, you'll own both manual testing and automation across our mobile portfolio, and you'll drive
   

  

 our releases — ensuring our deliverables ship on time and at a high quality bar. You'll work AI\-first, using modern AI tools to accelerate
   

  

 nearly every aspect of your day\-to\-day
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Proven, hands\-on SQA experience — manual testing fundamentals, test case design, test planning, defect identification and reporting
* Expertise in deriving test cases from requirements, with proactive communication to identify and resolve requirement gaps
* Strong testing methodology: functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and edge\-case analysis
* Hands\-on experience with mobile test automation frameworks such as Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest
* Test management and defect tracking discipline (Jira, BrowserStack)
* A relentless drive toward quality — constantly grooming the defect backlog and driving it to closure, with the goal of moving toward a
* zero\-defect backlog
* Experience testing Android and iOS apps — native and React Native (or strong willingness and aptitude to learn the platforms on the
* job)
* Understanding of mobile\-specific testing concerns: different form factors (varying phone sizes, tablets) and multiple mobile OS
* versions, plus app lifecycle, offline/sync, and performance
* An AI\-native mindset — you see AI as a force multiplier for QA, not a replacement, and are ready to drive your day\-to\-day almost
* entirely through AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and similar) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, documentation, and release
* coordination
* Strong written and verbal communication, with proactive, consistent follow\-ups that drive items to closure without being chased
* An ownership mentality across the testing and release lifecycle, with a continuous\-learning attitude toward AI tooling and mobile
* testing innovations
* You thrive in cross\-functional collaboration and build strong relationships with product, engineering, design, and DevOps teams


**About You**
* Prior coding experience in Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Swift; candidates without it should bring strong aptitude and
* willingness to learn automation and scripting on the job
* Experience driving projects, coordinating across teams, and managing release timelines
* Exposure to app store release processes (App Store Connect, Google Play Console)
* Awareness of mobile security testing concepts
* A strategic quality mindset — shaping team culture, establishing meaningful quality metrics, and driving continuous improvement
* Bachelor's/Master's in CS or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* \~10\+ years in SQA, with senior/principal\-level scope and impact; track record of high\-quality, consumer\-facing software delivery


**What's Next**
 After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process:
   

  

* TA Call
* Technical Interview
* Final Interview \- Hiring Manager (Virtual or face\-to\-face)

title: Test Lead
description:

 Serve as a Test Lead for manufacturing execution solutions overseeing validation and automated testing for complex MES environments that integrate levels L2 to L4 and leverage generative AI capabilities. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure robust quality regulatory compliance and reliable delivery of Camstar MES solutions in a hybrid work model for global manufacturing and supply chain programs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end test planning for MES validation programs by defining scope objectives estimations and timelines that align with project milestones and quality expectations for global manufacturing stakeholders.
* Oversee design of comprehensive test strategies that cover MES Val automated testing MES Val manual testing and integration scenarios across MES L2 L3 and L4 layers to assure resilient and predictable system behavior.
* Drive creation and maintenance of detailed test cases and test scripts for Camstar MES flows to validate production quality and supply chain processes while complying with internal quality standards and external regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate execution of manual and automated test cycles in a hybrid work environment ensuring that test data environments and tools are prepared in advance to avoid delays and rework.
* Provide hands on guidance in configuring and running automated test suites for MES workflows including regression and performance tests to increase test coverage and reduce release cycle time.
* Analyze complex defects discovered during MES validation and integration testing perform structured root cause analysis and work closely with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution and prevention actions.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain domain experts to translate process requirements into testable scenarios that reflect real world production conditions and supplier constraints.
* Leverage generative AI capabilities to accelerate test artifact creation such as test scenarios test data sets and defect summaries while ensuring that outputs are reviewed and aligned with project standards.
* Prepare clear test reports and quality dashboards that summarize execution status defect trends and release readiness so that project stakeholders can make informed go or no go decisions.
* Engage with integration teams to validate data and process flows between Camstar MES and surrounding systems at L2 L3 and L4 levels ensuring accurate timely and secure information exchange.
* Ensure adherence to organizational quality frameworks validation procedures and documentation practices so that audit readiness and traceability are maintained across all MES testing activities.
* Mentor junior testers on MES validation concepts automated testing practices and defect management workflows so that the overall capability and efficiency of the test team continuously improves.
* Coordinate with project managers and architects to identify testing risks early propose mitigation strategies and adjust test plans when project scope or timelines evolve.


**Qualifications**
* Display proven experience of ten to fourteen years in software testing with substantial tenure as a Test Lead responsible for complex enterprise applications and multi phase releases.
* Possess strong hands on expertise in MES Val automated testing and MES Val manual testing including test design execution and optimization of test coverage for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrate deep practical knowledge of MES L2 L3 and L4 integration patterns including message flows event handling and data consistency considerations across plant floor and enterprise layers.
* Show solid working experience with Camstar MES configuration workflows and validation activities so that core manufacturing and quality operations can be thoroughly verified before deployment.
* Apply understanding of generative AI concepts and tools to support test documentation generation test data creation and exploratory test design under appropriate review and governance.
* Bring domain exposure in manufacturing and supply chain processes such as production execution material management quality tracking and traceability in order to design realistic and risk focused test scenarios.
* Utilize strong skills in defect management test management and collaboration tools along with clear communication capabilities to partner effectively with distributed cross functional teams in a hybrid work setup.
* Maintain a continuous learning mindset by staying current with advances in MES technologies automated testing frameworks and AI driven quality engineering practices relevant to the role.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e\-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top\-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection.  Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
   

  

 Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.

**About The Team**
 Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We increase selection by on\-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. title: BESS - SCADA Design and Testing Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 You will be a part of the Energy Storage \& Automation Engineering team and support the engineering, design, development, testing, and commissioning of SCADA systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Automation projects. Your work will primarily involve developing SCADA architecture, HMI/graphical screens, communication interfaces, databases, and remote monitoring solutions using industry\-standard tools such as Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, and PostgreSQL.
   

  

 You will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering engineering activities based on project requirements while coordinating closely with cross\-functional teams including Control \& Protection, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Project Management, and Commissioning teams. In the absence of your Lead Engineer, you may be required to interact directly with customers, vendors, and other stakeholders to resolve technical queries and ensure successful project execution.
   

  

 The role offers the opportunity to work on advanced energy automation solutions, integrating Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Inverters, Protection IEDs, PLCs, RTUs, and cloud\-based monitoring applications for utility\-scale projects.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Design and develop SCADA systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) automation applications.
* Develop and configure HMI/SCADA screens, dashboards, alarm management, trends, and reporting solutions using Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, and Zenon SCADA platforms.
* Configure and maintain PostgreSQL databases for historian data, alarm logs, event management, and operational reporting.
* Implement communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850, MQTT, and REST APIs.
* Design and configure web\-based SCADA solutions enabling secure remote monitoring and control.
* Perform SCADA system integration, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning support activities.
* Configure alarms, trends, reports, historian functions, user management, and cybersecurity settings.
* Troubleshoot communication issues, SCADA performance problems, and field device integration challenges.
* Prepare technical documentation including system design documents, configuration manuals, testing procedures, and user guides.
* Collaborate effectively with Electrical Engineering, Control Software Development, Cybersecurity, Project Management, and Commissioning teams.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and project stakeholders during project execution.
* Adhere to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards, and specifications.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Must have 5\-10 years of experience in SCADA system design, development, integration, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience in utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Solar Plants, Substations, Power Systems, or Industrial Automation applications.
* Strong experience with Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, Zenon, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent SCADA platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL and other SQL databases for SCADA historian and reporting applications.
* Good understanding of Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Inverters, and power conversion systems.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850, MQTT, and REST APIs.
* Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern HMI development frameworks is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with SCADA cybersecurity, secure communication practices, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
* Understanding of applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, ANSI, ISO, and utility communication standards.
* Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of SCADA systems.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global engineering environment.


 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required

**About Pearson** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We are building the world’s leading learning company by providing digital content, assessments, and services that support learners at every stage.
 


  

  


 As part of Pearson’s Chief Technology Office (OCTO), the Keystone Data Governance team is responsible for enabling trusted, high\-quality, and compliant data across the enterprise. We are transforming how data is governed by embedding automation, scalability, and modern data engineering practices into our governance model.
 


  

  


**The Role** 



  

  


 We are seeking highly motivated
 **Data Governance Engineers** 
 to join our Chennai\-based team. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building and scaling automated Data Governance capabilities across Pearson’s data ecosystem.
 


  

  


 This role is primarily an
 **engineering\-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands\-on engineering, 20–30% governance\-related work)** 
 . The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance\-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.
 


  

  


 You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  


**Governance Engineering \& Automation** 



  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.

**Collibra Platform \& Integration** 



  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API\-based integrations.
  

  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  

  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  


  


**Metadata \& Data Catalog Management** 



  

  
* Support the build\-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  

  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  

  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  


  


**Data Quality Engineering** 



  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  

  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  

  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  


  


**Data Compliance, Security \& Privacy** 



  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  

  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  

  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  


  


**Data Engineering \& Integration** 



  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  

  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  

  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  


  


**Collaboration \& Delivery** 



  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand\-up meetings with US\-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  

  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  

  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  


  


**Qualifications** 



  

  


**Required (Core Engineering Skills)** 



  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical field.
  

  
* 3–6\+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related roles.
  

  
* Strong programming and data engineering experience (e.g., Python, SQL).
  

  
* Hands\-on experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, microservices).
  

  
* Familiarity with modern cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
  


  


**Preferred (Data Governance \& Domain Experience – can be developed on the job)** 



  

  
* Understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  

  
* Experience with data governance tools, preferably Collibra.
  

  
* Experience implementing data catalog, lineage, or metadata management solutions.
  

  
* Exposure to data quality frameworks and monitoring tools.
  

  
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance principles (e.g., PII, access controls).
  

  
* Experience designing and implementing data pipelines or integrating data from multiple sources.
  

  
* Experience working in global, cross\-functional teams.
  


  


**Skills \& Attributes** 



  

  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
  

  
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  

  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  

  
* Self\-starter with a focus on delivering scalable, high\-quality solutions.

description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

 KLA's eBeam Division is looking for passionate software developers to join us and help define and deliver high\-quality solutions for our current generation and next generation products in our Wafer Inspection and Review product lines. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be responsible to build software solutions for the machine control software of our products which would have a direct impact on the semi\-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all.
   

  

 You will fit right in if you have a good understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science. Are you somebody who enjoys working on complex software, is very keen on understanding customer use cases and enjoys, understands the big picture? You will work with exceptional talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to learn, contribute and collaborate in developing end\-to\-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on learning and applying clean coding practices. Having a keen interest and ability to analyze problems and tackle them would be critical in this role.
   

  

 Knowledge of Object\-Oriented software analysis and design, Microsoft .Net or C\+\+ programming would also be important.

* Implement machine control software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions.
* Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource intensive software requirements to optimize and enhance performance of the hardware system. Good software documentation skills are required.
* Be willing to learn new design principles, technologies and business use\-cases is essential.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. **Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**

* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**

 :

* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.

description:

* Design and implement AI agents using LLMs, planning algorithms, and decision\-making frameworks.

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**

* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non\-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Safeguard a global post\-trade platform — Your test automation will directly protect the reliability of a system used daily by investment managers, broker/dealers, and custodian banks worldwide, where a single defect can carry real financial and regulatory consequences.
* Raise the quality bar across the SDLC — You will embed quality earlier and deeper into delivery, shifting testing left and enabling faster, more confident releases without compromising stability.
* Accelerate delivery through AI\-augmented testing — By leveraging AI for test generation, self\-healing UI locators, and reusable automation assets, you'll reduce manual test effort, shorten regression cycles, and free the team to focus on higher\-value work.
* De\-risk a major platform modernization — Your validation of Oracle\-to\-PostgreSQL database migrations will ensure data integrity and functional parity as the platform modernizes, protecting the business from migration\-related regressions.
* Elevate the engineering team — Through technical leadership and mentorship, you'll uplift the QA engineering team's skills, establish automation best practices, and create a durable culture of quality ownership.
* Enable full\-stack confidence — By driving coverage across UI, API, database, and integration layers of a multi\-service containerized architecture, you'll give stakeholders end\-to\-end assurance that the platform behaves correctly at every tier.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 7\+ years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* 7\+ years of hands\-on test automation engineering, ideally within complex, large\-scale enterprise or financial platforms.
* Deep expertise in keyword\-driven / data\-driven automation frameworks, including designing, extending, and maintaining reusable framework components.
* Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Java, or C\# for building robust, maintainable automation.
* Proven experience automating across multiple layers — UI, REST/SOAP API, database, and end\-to\-end integration testing.
* Solid database and SQL proficiency, with practical experience validating data across relational systems (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and testing data migrations.
* Working knowledge of containerized, microservices architectures (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) and testing in distributed, multi\-service environments.
* Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab) for continuous testing.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing tools for test generation, self\-healing locators, or intelligent test maintenance is a strong plus.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and setting technical direction for a testing practice.
* Capital markets, post\-trade, or broader financial services domain experience is highly desirable.

title: C++ Technical Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Chennai,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground\-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high\-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain complex software solutions for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Equipment Automation (EA)
* Strong understanding of Operating Systems (Windows/Linux), Networking fundamentals and protocols, Data Structures and Algorithms, Object\-Oriented Design and Design Patterns, Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) and RPC technologies.
* Analyze business and system requirements and translate them into scalable software architecture, detailed design specifications, and implementation plans.
* Develop high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-documented software using C/C\+\+, C\#, .NET, and related technologies following established coding standards and best practices.
* Own software features throughout the development lifecycle, including design, implementation, unit testing, integration testing, deployment, and post\-release support.
* Develop and maintain software documentation, design specifications, test procedures, and release notes.
* Troubleshoot, analyze root causes, and resolve complex software issues across distributed systems; design and implement robust bug fixes and performance improvements.
* Define and execute software verification and validation strategies, including test plans for simulators, test benches, laboratory environments, and production systems.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and architectural discussions to ensure software quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product management, quality assurance, and customer support teams.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external customers for requirements gathering, project planning, issue resolution, and technical troubleshooting.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for productivity enhancements, and software modernization.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on software design, development practices, and problem\-solving methodologies.
* Lead small to medium\-sized technical projects and drive deliverables to completion with minimal supervision.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of software development experience in enterprise, industrial automation, MES, manufacturing, or related domains.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Factory Automation, Semiconductor Equipment Software, or Industrial Control Systems.
* Experience with distributed systems, service\-oriented architectures, and modern software development methodologies.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and source control systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles and system integration.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence design decisions, and drive engineering excellence.
* Proven leadership skills with experience leading small projects, mentoring engineers, and coordinating cross\-functional teams.
* Strong knowledge of industry best practices, software quality standards, secure coding practices, and business processes.

 Full time
   

  

**Employee Type:**
 Assignee / Regular

 Not Specified

 Yes

title: Tech S And T Product Engineer-Ardoq-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 \- Product Engineer \- Ardoq
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 3 to 7 years
   

  

**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We are looking for a Product Engineer – Ardoq to develop, configure, integrate, and enhance Ardoq\-based enterprise architecture solutions. The role combines Ardoq platform engineering, Python development, API integrations, data engineering, and AI\-enabled analysis.The candidate will work with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and technology teams to automate data ingestion, improve architecture data quality, and generate actionable insights from enterprise information.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, views, surveys, and permissions.
* Model applications, business capabilities, technologies, integrations, data flows, risks, and technical debt.
* Develop Python utilities and services for data ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and synchronization.
* Integrate Ardoq with systems such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, AWS, and other enterprise platforms.
* Build and maintain REST API integrations using JSON, HTTPS, authentication tokens, and service accounts.
* Apply AI and Large Language Models to analyze enterprise data, identify technical debt, classify findings, summarize issues, and generate recommendations.
* Develop and maintain AI prompts, response schemas, validation rules, and guardrails.
* Implement scheduled imports, data mappings, reconciliation, error handling, logging, and monitoring.
* Create Ardoq dashboards, visualizations, reports, and stakeholder\-specific architecture views.
* Support application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management, capability mapping, and application rationalization.
* Investigate and resolve integration, platform, access, AI\-output, and data\-quality issues.
* Prepare technical designs, integration specifications, operational runbooks, and user documentation.


**Must\-Have Skills:**
* 3 to 7 years of experience in product engineering, enterprise architecture tooling, integration development, or platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience of Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, visualizations, surveys, and integrations.
* Strong Python programming skills, including API clients, data processing, automation, and error handling.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API tokens, and integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with AI services such as Azure OpenAI or equivalent enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector search, AI agents, and prompt evaluation.
* Experience with Python frameworks and libraries such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pandas, and Pytest.
* Experience with data transformation, validation, mapping, synchronization, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of business, application, data, integration, and technology architecture.
* Practical knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, grounding, and response validation.
* Experience using Git and standard software\-development practices such as code reviews, testing, and version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience integrating Ardoq with ServiceNow CMDB, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, or AWS.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and database integration.
* Experience with Application Portfolio Management and Technology Portfolio Management.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and cloud\-native application deployment.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Postman, Swagger, OpenAPI, Power BI, and API\-management platforms.
* Exposure to technical debt assessment, technology risk, lifecycle tracking, and application rationalization.
* Familiarity with Ardoq ShiftX and business process modelling.


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
   

  

**Certifications(Added Advantage):**
* Ardoq Academy or Ardoq Partner certification
* Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate

description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Automation QA JavaScript Engineer** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Automation QA JavaScript Engineer to join the project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise\-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non\-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.
   

  

 You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long\-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi\-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure\-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative\-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic\-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role where we establish the production\-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign\-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent\-a\-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Platform \& Agent Test Automation
+ Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent developer experience as the SDK evolves
+ Build automated tests for long\-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable\-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
+ Automate multi\-tenant isolation verification cross\-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost\-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
+ Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations

* AI\-Specific \& Non\-Deterministic Testing
+ Design test strategies for LLM\-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass consistency), semantic\-similarity scoring, confidence\-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
+ Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document\-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool\-call hijack, and data\-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red\-team taxonomies
+ Verify Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
+ Partner with the evaluation function on golden\-dataset\-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic\-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable

* Performance, Reliability \& NFR Verification
+ Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95\), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
+ Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first\-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost\-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs

* Process, Evidence \& Collaboration
+ Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per\-metric regression flagging on pull requests
+ Produce auditable, reproducible test\-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign\-off
+ Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
+ Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
+ Mentor mid\-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
* Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-powered or other non\-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual\-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
* Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
* Solid SQL and data\-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test\-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
* A security\-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt\-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
* Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non\-engineering stakeholders
* Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
* QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript\-based) and integrating them into high\-security CI/CD pipelines
* AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems
* Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning


**Desirable**
* Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
* Prior testing of multi\-tenant SaaS isolation
* Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
* Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
* Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document\-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
* Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
* Performance Testing: Experience testing high\-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
* Experience with qTest for test management


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

**Project Role Description :** 
 Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end\-to\-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Data Warehouse ETL Testing
   

  

**Good to have skills :**

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Test Automation Engineer, a typical day involves applying quality processes and leveraging automation tools and methodologies to enhance testing products and solutions. The role centers on managing the entire quality engineering function with a strong emphasis on automation, aiming to elevate control, accuracy, and data integrity throughout the testing lifecycle. This position requires continuous engagement with evolving testing frameworks and collaboration with various teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify automation opportunities and optimize testing processes.
* Maintain and enhance existing automation frameworks to ensure scalability and reliability.
* Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Data Warehouse ETL Testing.
* Strong knowledge of ETL processes, data validation techniques, and data quality assurance.
* Experience in designing and implementing automated test scripts for data pipelines and workflows.
* Familiarity with test management tools and defect tracking systems.
* Ability to analyze complex data sets and troubleshoot issues related to data extraction, transformation, and loading.
* Understanding of database concepts and query languages to validate data accuracy.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Data Warehouse ETL Testing.
* This position is based at our Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Integration and Testing engineer
description:
**Who Are We**
 Raptee.HV is a full\- stack electric motorcycle startup with a very strong technical moat, founded in 2019 by four engineers from Chennai (Ex Tesla, Wipro), working on bringing a no\-compromise upgrade motorcycle to an otherwise scooter\- only EV market. Raptee is incubated at CIIC \& ARAI.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Integration \& Testing Engineer** 
 to support the integration, validation, and testing of electric two\-wheeler systems. The role involves bringing together mechanical, electrical, electronics, battery, motor, vehicle control, firmware, and connected systems and ensuring that the complete vehicle meets defined performance, safety, reliability, and quality requirements.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Diagnose vehicle\-level electrical, electronic, software, and system integration issues.
* Analyze CAN logs, diagnostic data, DTCs, and test results.
* Perform structured root\-cause analysis using methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone, and 8D.
* Reproduce intermittent and field\-related issues and work with design teams for resolution.
* Verify fixes through regression testing.
* Prepare test plans, test cases, test reports, issue reports, and validation status reports.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results.
* Track issues through closure and ensure proper verification of corrective actions.
* Maintain vehicle configuration and test build records.


**Who Can Apply**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related field.
* Candidates with exposure or knowledge in EV, automotive electronics, EMS, or Tier\-1/Tier\-2 automotive suppliers.
* Interest in identifying P2P/component benchmarking.
* Knowledge of semiconductor and electronic component and dynamics.
* Exposure to PCB/PCBA manufacturing, testing, tooling, and yield\-related cost drivers.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with a focus on testing and benchmarking.


**What’s In It For You**
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Opportunities for professional advancement as the company undergoes expansion.
* A culture that fosters collaboration and creativity within the team.
* Collaborate closely with seasoned experts in the field.
* Gaining an entry point into the field of automobile development.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 Test Engineer Associate Director role will enable the organization to accelerate Data Governance and Metadata Management initiatives while reducing operational, regulatory, and audit risks. Through automation, governance domain expertise, and deep knowledge of metadata, lineage, Snowflake, Collibra, and Atacama platforms, the role will improve platform quality, enhance compliance readiness, increase delivery velocity, and establish a scalable testing capability that supports enterprise\-wide governance and AI\-driven data initiatives
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Define and drive test strategy across functional, regression, integration, performance, resiliency, and automation testing to ensure enterprise quality standards are met.
* Lead test automation initiatives by developing reusable frameworks, improving automation coverage, and promoting continuous quality practices
* Own release quality and production readiness, ensuring appropriate test coverage, regression execution, testing signoffs, and readiness approvals before production deployments.
* Provide leadership and mentoring to SDETs and test engineers while establishing testing standards, KPIs, and best practices.
* Partner closely with Agile squads, including Product Owners, Technology Leads, Developers, and Scrum Masters to define testable requirements and support sprint execution
* Ensure governance and compliance by maintaining traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results while adhering to DTCC SDLC, risk, security, and audit requirements.
* Manage defects, risks, and quality metrics, driving issues to resolution and escalating risks that could impact delivery or production stability.
* Oversee non\-functional testing, including performance, capacity, stress, resiliency, environment, and infrastructure testing to validate platform reliability and operational readiness


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Talents Needed For Success**
* 5\+ years of experience in data governance and metadata management
* 5\+ years of development experience in Testing Automations, metadata management tools like Collibra, Atacama,
* 4\+ years with ALM tools, Java/Python/ UNIX environments/SQL and Snowflake experience etc., relevant for testing automations
* Strong understanding of data cataloging, metadata management, data lineage, and data controls.
* Experience with data integration frameworks and governance tooling.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven metadata enrichment and automation is preferred.
* Ability to handle teams in executing the testing frameworks across multiple projects
* Ability to quickly understand and adapt to new tools, platforms, and project requirements.
* Strong documentation skills for both technical and business audiences.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and multitasking capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with business, engineering, and leadership teams.
* Strong interpersonal, customer service, and verbal/written communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum).
* Proven ability to manage timelines and deliverables effectively.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
